headline: Interview candidates for Assistant Executive Director position, then vote on possible job offer.
summary: The board will interview candidates for the Assistant Executive Director position. It may go into executive session to discuss applicants' reputation and character, then take action on a possible job offer.

Ms. Lisa Kent, City Clerk
Beverly City Hall
Beverly, MA 01915

October 13, 2026

Dear Ms. Kent:

# BEVERLY RETIREMENT BOARD SPECIAL MEETING

**Date:** October 16, 2026

**Location:** Beverly Retirement Board, 275 Rantoul Street, Beverly, MA 01915

**Time:** 9:00 AM

## AGENDA

Open Session: Call to Order

Interview of candidates for Assistant Executive Director position.

Motion for Proposed Executive Session Pursuant to M.G.L. c.30A, §21(a)(8): motion by roll call.

To discuss the reputation and character of applicants for employment for the Assistant Executive Director position.

The board will reconvene into open session upon conclusion of executive session.

Potential action regarding offer of employment to candidates.

Adam Travinski
Executive Director
